## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what changes for a user.

## Evidence and scope

Link the issue, relevant specification/evidence or independently calculated vectors. State UNKNOWNs and compatibility limits. Confirm submitted code/assets are original or appropriately licensed; do not attach vendor binaries, recovered source or private data.

## Validation

- Checks run, exact commands and results:
- Demo/simulator or physical device (hardware testing is optional):
- OS, Python/Qt versions and commit/device details when relevant:
- UI screenshot if the layout changed:

## Review checklist

- [ ] Changes are focused and documented.
- [ ] Unsupported/lossy behavior is rejected explicitly; no new unconfirmed protocol guesses.
- [ ] No automatic physical device writes or global input capture were introduced.
- [ ] Relevant tests/checks passed, or limitations are explained.
- [ ] Dependency/license notices were updated if needed.
